My staffing audit this week verified that Mr. Hall's contract permits him to cover at most three class periods per day, and Ms. Nguyen's contract permits her to cover at most two class periods per day. I have not yet added these limits to the absence plan, so they wouldn't be visible to anyone reviewing the draft. This means the current draft assigning Mr. Hall to all five chemistry class periods may exceed his contractual limit depending on how those periods are distributed across days, and any revised plan assigning Ms. Nguyen to Tuesday and Thursday practicals plus the Friday makeup session needs to account for her two-period-per-day limit."}

transcript.text: Thank you, Ms. Brooks, for flagging those contractual limits. From the counseling side, my concern is specifically about preserving that Friday 3:30 to 4:30 p.m. makeup window for the four seniors. If Ms. Nguyen's two-period-per-day limit applies to the Friday makeup session as well, we need to confirm whether that window can still be staffed. If not, we have a serious problem — this is the only available time these students can complete the practical before May 30, and their family transportation is already confirmed for that window. I would also like to note that I will enter this makeup window into the student-support calendar immediately after this huddle so it is visible going forward.

decisions.coverage_plan: Revise the plan so that Mr. Hall covers non-lab chemistry periods only, up to a maximum of three class periods per day per his contract. Ms. Nguyen covers the Tuesday and Thursday required practicals and the Friday 3:30-4:30 p.m. senior makeup session, up to a maximum of two class periods per day per her contract. The specific period assignments must be distributed to respect both contractual limits.
decisions.laboratory_practicals: Tuesday and Thursday practicals will proceed as scheduled with Ms. Nguyen physically present as the certified chemistry teacher, per state lab policy. Lab work is not postponed for those days. Mr. Ibarra will forward the updated department calendar to the coverage system immediately after this huddle.
decisions.senior_makeup_session: Friday 3:30-4:30 p.m. makeup window is preserved and will be staffed by Ms. Nguyen, subject to her two-period-per-day contractual limit. Mr. Chen will enter this makeup window into the student-support calendar immediately after this huddle.

commitments.detail: Forward the updated department calendar to the coverage system immediately after this huddle so the required practicals are visible.
Enter the Friday 3:30-4:30 p.m. makeup window into the student-support calendar immediately after this huddle.
Add Mr. Hall's three-period-per-day and Ms. Nguyen's two-period-per-day contractual limits to the absence plan so they are visible in the coverage system.
Approve and post the revised coverage plan to the faculty coverage system only after all commitments are completed and contractual limits are verified.
